item.title: Iranian officials praise Pezeshkian’s UN speech as expression of national unity

item.title: US appeasers will learn too late that submission offers no salvation: Tehran
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei says that countries seeking refuge under US power would eventually learn that turning away from reality and sacrificing their dignity offers no protection, in a pointed message to Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney over his response to a US threat to “annihilate” Iran.

item.title: Iran embassy in Indonesia highlights Pezeshkian’s UN message
item.description: Iran’s embassy in Indonesia posted an image on social media on Thursday featuring excerpts from President Masoud Pezeshkian’s address to the United Nations General Assembly a day earlier, highlighting his messages that Iran is a victim of terrorism, that its power is for defense rather than aggression, and that Tehran remains ready for dialogue while rejecting the language of force.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/photo/86273286/Iran-embassy-in-Indonesia-highlights-Pezeshkian-s-UN-message

Iran’s embassy in Indonesia posted an image on social media on Thursday featuring excerpts from President Masoud Pezeshkian’s address to the United Nations General Assembly a day earlier, highlighting his messages that Iran is a victim of terrorism, that its power is for defense rather than aggression, and that Tehran remains ready for dialogue while rejecting the language of force.

item.title: Iran saw inaction, not neutrality, during recent war: Pezeshkian
item.description: New York, IRNA – President Masoud Pezeshkian told European Council President Antonio Costa on Wednesday that Iran had seen inaction rather than neutrality from some countries during the recent war, calling on European states to reconsider their approach and maintain greater independence.

item.title: Iran’s top security official: No return to pre-war diplomacy with US
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council (SNSC) Mohsen Rezaei has reiterated that Iran will not return to its pre-war diplomatic approach towardd the United States, calling on Washington to “take action” and meet Iran’s conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86272960/Iran-s-top-security-official-No-return-to-pre-war-diplomacy
